name: proto-unresolved-import
description: Under proto.import_paths, an import no import root resolves holds every declaration whose type it would supply, published live, and an unresolved-import note names the importing file; a declaration that needs nothing from the import is published too. Since a schema file that could not be read may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
